setup: Not Docker. start.sh self-bootstraps: python3 -m venv .venv; pip install torch --extra-index-url ${TORCH_INDEX_URL:-https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130}; pip install --no-build-isolation ${EXL3_REPO:-git+https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab/exllamav3} (CUDA kernel compile, 5-20 min; TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.0;12.1 auto-set on aarch64; MAX_JOBS 8 or 4); pip install aiohttp huggingface_hub; then snapshot_download of HF_TARGET_REPO (and HF_DRAFT_REPO for dflash2) into MODEL_DIR/DRAFT_DIR. Requires the MiaAI-Lab exllamav3 fork (nvfp4/fp8 KV and DFlash2 are fork-only). Config via .env (copied from .env.example).
